title: The Extraordinary story of the rescue
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：extraordinary　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 extraordinary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the elder wrote of ① an extraordinary story of the rescue in the memoir, and everybody in the village said at once that it was ② more extraordinary than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the elder, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the extraordinary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most extraordinary story of the rescue anybody in the village had ever seen, or so the memoir for November 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too extraordinary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the youth who had come to help; the extraordinary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an extraordinary coincidence in the dates, and said that no youth in his right mind would call it ⑥ as extraordinary as the coincidence in the dates they had once had in the old village. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was extraordinary or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the memoir. What the line asked for was ⑦ something extraordinary, and nothing besides. The youth from the next village called the whole plan ⑧ quite extraordinary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the memoir kept the names of the extraordinary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, in public, she wrote of another extraordinary story of the rescue in the same memoir, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more extraordinary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most extraordinary coincidence in the dates in the whole village, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the extraordinary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 非凡（前置定语 an extraordinary story of the rescue：1966 年长者在回忆录里记下的那件非凡的经过）
B. adj. 非凡／离奇（比较级 more extraordinary than：文中两处，一处比营救的非凡经过，一处比预想）
C. adj. 非凡／离奇（最高级 the most extraordinary：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 非凡（表语 too extraordinary to do：母亲觉得它太非凡，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 离奇（前置定语 an extraordinary coincidence in the dates：叔叔把整件事称作一桩离奇的巧合）
F. adj. 离奇（同级比较 as extraordinary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩日期上的离奇巧合相比）
G. adj. 离奇（后置定语 something extraordinary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 离奇（受程度副词修饰 quite extraordinary：那位后生的评价）

items.q: an extraordinary story of the rescue
the most extraordinary story of the rescue anybody
an extraordinary coincidence in the dates
The most extraordinary coincidence in the dates in

answers.why: extraordinary 意为“非凡”，1966 年长者在回忆录里记下的是“一件非凡的经过”，此处作前置定语 an extraordinary story of the rescue。
extraordinary 意为“非凡”，此处用比较级 more extraordinary than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
extraordinary 意为“非凡”，回忆录上 十一月 那行字说它是村子里最非凡的一件，故用最高级 the most extraordinary story of the rescue。
extraordinary 意为“非凡”，母亲认为这件东西“太非凡了，谁也用不上”，too extraordinary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
extraordinary 意为“离奇”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩离奇的巧合”，此处作前置定语 an extraordinary coincidence in the dates。
extraordinary 意为“离奇”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩日期上的离奇巧合一样离奇”，同级比较用 as extraordinary as。
extraordinary 意为“离奇”，回忆录上那半行字要的是“离奇的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something extraordinary。
extraordinary 意为“离奇”，邻村子来的那位后生认为这套计划“相当离奇”，quite 修饰原级 extraordinary。
extraordinary 意为“离奇”，1976 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要离奇”，故用比较级 more extraordinary than。
extraordinary 意为“离奇”，母亲 1978 年说的是“整个村子里最离奇的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most extraordinary coincidence in the dates。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，长者在回忆录里记下了一件非凡的经过。（an extraordinary story of the rescue）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更非凡。（more extraordinary than …）
母亲觉得它太非凡，谁也用不上。（too extraordinary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩离奇的巧合。（an extraordinary coincidence in the dates）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩日期上的离奇巧合一样离奇。（as extraordinary as …）
到了 1973 年，回忆录上只剩半行字：要的是一件离奇的东西。（something extraordinary）
answers: In 1966 the elder wrote of an extraordinary story of the rescue in the memoir.
Everybody said it was more extraordinary than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too extraordinary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an extraordinary coincidence in the dates.
He said nobody would call it as extraordinary as the coincidence in the dates they had once had.
By 1973 the memoir asked for nothing but something extraordinary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 extraordinary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the elder wrote of an extraordinary story of the rescue in the memoir, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most extraordinary story of the rescue in the village, or so the memoir says.
My mother thought it too extraordinary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an extraordinary coincidence in the dates, and nobody argued with him.
The youth from the next village called the plan quite extraordinary, and everybody laughed.
The extraordinary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
